## Skill contract

- [ ] The skill has one narrow mission.
- [ ] `name` matches `yt-<lowercase-kebab-case>` and the folder name.
- [ ] The frontmatter description says when the skill should activate.
- [ ] Required/optional inputs are explicit.
- [ ] Workflow is deterministic and numbered.
- [ ] Output contract is fixed and reusable.
- [ ] Quality gates prohibit fabricated analytics/claims.
- [ ] Failure handling is explicit.
- [ ] `community-skills.json` is updated.
- [ ] A smoke-test prompt is included.
- [ ] `python tools/validate_skills.py` passes locally.
- [ ] `python tools/build_catalog.py` has been run.
